docs.message:
docs(pdt42): apply the six Platform Plays to "Getting apps into use" (E6)

## Intent

Show how a platform could change the value chain of the focus arena. Attention for contributed apps is the scarce resource: building an app has become cheap, but being noticed by anyone other than its creator has not.

## Key changes

- A new E6 chapter applies the six Platform Plays, with PP2 (bring creators on top) as the central play.
- PP1 personalises on the website only: local storage and collections carried in a link or QR code. A website backend stays a later option, never for the apps and never with student accounts.
- PP3 standardises the app listing, PP4 is the guidance for AI agents, PP5 a visible signal of fitness for use, PP6 one overview of scattered apps and seekers.
- On the Wardley Map the app, discoverability and the signal of fitness for use move to product.
- The development plan marks E6 done and adds KD-07.
